definition: to turn your eyes away from something
description: In a farmhouse kitchen, a shaggy ginger Highland cow pushes its big head in over the lower half of a stable door and sticks out its pink tongue towards a young woman with a messy bun, in a cream cable-knit jumper, sitting at a wooden table. She turns her head sharply away with her eyes screwed shut, laughing, and holds up one hand to block the cow, while the cow keeps reaching for her with its tongue. Spilled oats lie on the table next to an enamel jug, and pots hang on the wall behind.
